0: The same and Anna Andreyevna. ANNA [seeing Khlestakov on his knees]. Oh, what a situation!
2: ANNA [to Marya]. What does this mean? What does this behavior mean?
4: ANNA. Go away from here. Do you hear? And don't you dare to show your face to me. [Marya goes out in tears.] Excuse me. I must say I'm greatly astonished.
6: KHLESTAKOV [aside]. She's very appetizing, too. She's not bad-looking, either. [Flings himself on his knees.] Madam, you see I am burning with love.
8: ANNA. What! You on your knees? Please get up, please get up. This floor isn't very clean.
9: KHLESTAKOV. No, I must be on my knees before you. I must. Pronounce the verdict. Is it life or death?
10: ANNA. But please—I don't quite understand the significance of your words. If I am not mistaken, you are making a proposal for my daughter.
11: KHLESTAKOV. No, I am in love with you. My life hangs by a thread. If you don't crown my steadfast love, then I am not fit to exist in this world. With a burning flame in my bosom, I pray for your hand.
12: ANNA. But please remember I am in a certain way—married.
13: KHLESTAKOV. That's nothing. Love knows no distinction. It was Karamzin who said: "The laws condemn." We will fly in the shadow of a brook. Your hand! I pray for your hand!
